description: Tests §8.9 failure handling, not extraction. The conversation is ordinary; what varies is the MODEL RESPONSE, supplied via recorded fixtures (fenced JSON, prose-wrapped JSON, truncated JSON, pure garbage). A response the parser cannot read must surface as a visible failure (unreadable), never as a silent 'no memories'. Fenced/prose-wrapped-but-recoverable responses must still be salvaged. This fixture is inherently a recorded/offline test: a live model cannot be forced to emit malformed output on demand.

conversation.content: I switched my default browser to Firefox and I'm never going back to Chrome.

expected.note: Recoverable responses (fenced/prose-wrapped) should still yield this.
